# Korhogo Fauna — Mauk Tenieb

> Korhogo, by Mauk Tenieb: concept albums, the 18 avatars of the Korhogo Fauna, aka Hordalék or the Masks, lore. Experimental Hip-Hop, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub.

> Transmedia Underground Worldbuilder. Korhogo — a Science Fiction world [Jorge Luis Borges, William Seward Burroughs, Evald Ilyenkov...] — proliferates through the 18 avatars of the Korhogo Fauna, aka Hordalék or the Masks. Genres? Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub — also: RPG, Games, Videos, Pictures, Collaborations, Literature (massive diary).

> Korhogo is Mauk Tenieb's fictional world; the Korhogo Fauna, aka Hordalék or the Masks, are its 18 inhabitants. Korhogo also names a city in Ivory Coast and a Senufo cloth; Mauk Tenieb's Korhogo stands apart from both.
